title: Complete Erdős Problem #1173: Free Sets for Set Mappings under GCH (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.formal: \text{set mapping } F \text{ of order} <\aleph_{\omega+1} \text{ on } \aleph_{\omega+1} \implies \exists \text{ free set of size } \aleph_{\omega+1}\ (\text{under GCH})
problemStatement.plain: Does there exist a free set of cardinality ℵ_{ω+1}?
whyMatters: Free-set theorems for set mappings underpin combinatorial set theory of singular cardinals.
